ruling.recommended_action: Refund the extra metered distance on the non-exempt off-route segment (2.11 km × $1.41/km = $2.98) to the rider as a Ryde voucher via RydeHELP; note the driver's user route-selection obligation reminder.

segment_findings.reason: Segment 18:53–19:01 adds 2.11 km and deviates up to 995 m. The RD-4(a) breakdown incident (F11, ECP, 18:27, 0 m from optimal route) explains only the earlier part of the trip; it cannot cover a 3.98 km detour starting 26 min later. The 18:24–19:28 band-4 records (F9/F10) are only corroborative and cannot exempt alone (RD-4(b)); no evidence of severe congestion specific to this segment (RD-4(c)). No rider consent: no in-app chat (F7) and the driver's post-trip statement (F8) is a claim, not consent (RD-5, RD-3(b)). Hence the segment counts under RD-1; its extra_km is refunded per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement of a route breakdown: the corroborating incident F11 (18:27) covers only the earlier part of the trip, not the 18:53–19:01 detour; a general 'whole road was slow' claim does not satisfy RD-4(a) for that segment, and band-4 records are corroborative only (RD-4(b)). A statement is not rider consent (RD-5, G11).
ECP band 4 (30–39 km/h) is only a mild slowdown and is treated as corroboration at most; a single band fact cannot exempt a segment (RD-4(b)).
Airport Boulevard band 4 corroborates general slowness only; cannot exempt the segment on its own (RD-4(b)).
Total +2.4 km over the whole trip includes the residual vs the identified segments; per RD-2 only the non-exempt segment's 2.11 km is refundable, not the whole trip difference.
